name: Loftely
positioning: Logiciel français de gestion de conciergerie et location courte durée : réservations, ménages, facturation propriétaire, hébergé en France.
description: Loftely is a French management platform for short-term rental concierge companies, centralizing bookings synced across platforms via iCal, automated cleaning and maintenance task scheduling triggered by each reservation, owner invoicing and a dedicated owner portal, and multilingual digital guidebooks, priced per active property per month with the first property free.
description_fr: Loftely est une plateforme française de gestion pour les conciergeries de location courte durée, qui centralise les réservations synchronisées entre plateformes via iCal, la planification automatique des tâches de ménage et d'entretien déclenchées par chaque réservation, la facturation propriétaire avec un espace dédié, et des livrets d'accueil multilingues, facturée par logement actif et par mois avec le premier logement gratuit.
real_estate_use: A concierge company managing a portfolio of seasonal rentals needs bookings from Airbnb, Booking.com and other channels to land in one calendar, each new reservation to automatically create its cleaning and check-in tasks for the field team, and the resulting activity to flow into the property owner's monthly invoice and portal — instead of reconciling separate booking, task and billing tools by hand.
features: Two-way iCal synchronization across booking platforms into one calendar
Automated task creation for cleaning, check-in and check-out per booking
Owner invoicing and a self-service owner portal

use_cases.job: Turn each new booking into scheduled cleaning and check-in tasks automatically
Track their own properties' bookings and invoices from a dedicated owner space

pricing.unit: par logement actif par mois, HT
